why_uzbekistan_text:
Studying in Uzbekistan can offer many opportunities for personal and academic growth. Uzbekistan has a rich cultural history and diverse population, which can provide students with a unique and rewarding experience.

Additionally, the country has a growing economy and a strong focus on education, with many universities and institutions offering programs in a wide variety of fields.

applicants_russia: Applicants in Russia have a huge choice:
access_variety: A variety of areas of study are available to you - from mathematics and natural sciences to acting
applicat_choose: At Russian universities you can get almost any profession in demand on the world market. The applicant only needs to choose the program that is optimal for him. Decide on the criteria (direction of study, city, form and language of study) and start your search.
foriegnhers_study: Foreigners, like Russians, can study at higher educational institutions in Russia at the expense of the Russian government budget or on a commercial basis.
education_financed: Education financed from the state budget
three_options: There are three options for admission to budget places financed by the Russian government. Candidates can:
educational_institution: If they have their own funds for education, applicants can choose the educational institution they like and contact its representatives. Most often, universities ask you to send your initial application by email, accompanied by the relevant documents.
register_admis: and submit your application directly to an unlimited number of universities at the same time. It's free and without intermediaries. You can also ask any question about studying in Russia to a representative of the university’s international department or the Study in Russia administrator. We are always happy to help you find the information you need.

medical_certificate_subtitle: about the absence of contraindications for studying in Russia with a note on the results of an HIV test (or a medical certificate).
first_stage_rule: At the first stage, as a rule, it is enough to provide certified and translated copies of an identity card and documents on existing education. At the second stage (upon arrival in Russia), you need to bring original documents and additional certificates to the university admissions office.
second_stage_rule: The staff will tell you more about what is needed to enter a university and what documents are needed at each stage:
documents_legalized: In most cases, documents need to be legalized in their home country. Applicants from some countries will also have to go through the procedure for recognition of their diplomas or certificates in Russia. Read more about this in the section “Legalization of an education document”.
initial_application: Initial application indicating the desired specialty and level of education available
official_submission: Official submission of documents to the university upon arrival in Russia.
documents_certificated: All documents must be translated into Russian and certified in the prescribed manner (notary or at the consular department of the embassy).
complete_documents: For a complete list of documents and certification procedures, please check with universities.
obtain_medical_service: You can obtain a medical certificate in your own country. The main thing is that it is valid in Russia (translated and certified) and meets the requirements of your university. In some cases, certificates provided when applying for a study visa may be suitable. You can also make a certificate upon arrival in the Russian Federation (form 086). Check with the international departments of universities for details.
entrance_exams: Entrance exams and Unified State Examination
general_basis: When entering a Russian university on a general basis, applicants present the results of the Unified State Exam (USE) or pass entrance tests. The Unified State Exam is an exam that all graduates of Russian schools take. Its results are accepted for admission to Russian universities. Foreign applicants can also take the Unified State Exam for admission to a university. All the necessary information can be found on the official website of the Unified State Exam. In addition, universities conduct entrance tests in the form of written or oral exams in subjects corresponding to the profile of the chosen specialty. Based on their results, a decision on enrollment is made. Some universities conduct separate entrance exams for foreigners.
dozen_olyimpics: Every year, dozens of Olympiads at various levels are held in Russia and abroad. The winners and runners-up of some of them can count on being admitted to Russian universities without exams or on preferential terms. Foreigners can participate in international Olympiads, in some all-Russian ones, as well as in various university associations held specifically for them. How to take part in the Olympiads.
russian_university: Many Russian universities, individually or jointly, conduct testing, based on the results of which they select talented foreign applicants. To do this, university representatives travel to various countries or send assignments to conduct tests. Applicants who show the best results during testing can count on benefits when entering Russian universities.
conducted_university: (conducted by universities specifically for foreign citizens)
education_equal_rights: Education on equal rights with citizens of the Russian Federation
international_universities: International departments of universities (if you apply independently)
repsresentiative_officces: Representative offices of Rossotrudnichestvo or the Russian Embassy in your country (if you are participating in a competitive selection for studying on a state scholarship).
application_countries: Applicants from countries that have a visa-free regime with Russia need to present a foreign passport to enter its territory (a list of countries that have a visa-free regime with Russia is provided on the website of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
apply_study_russia: In other cases, to enter the territory of Russia, in addition to an identity document, you must present a student visa. Read more in the section “How to apply for a study visa to Russia.”
apply_invitation: To apply for a study visa you will need an invitation:
invitation_foreigners: Invitations for foreigners are issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia (MFA of Russia) and the Main Directorate for Migration Issues of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
invitation_second_title: Applicants sent to universities based on the results of competitive selection for state scholarships (quota) receive visas as directed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. At the Rossotrudnichestvo representative office they are given a six-digit invitation number, which they call when submitting documents for a visa.
invitation_third_title: If the applicant entered the university on a general basis or on a commercial basis, then the university will send him an invitation. When applying for a visa, you will need the original of this document.
receive_confirmation: Receive confirmation of enrollment and invitation to the Russian Federation
exam_results: Find out about admission based on exam results on the university website
candidate_websites: Find yourself on the list of candidates on the websites of the Rossotrudnichestvo representative office or the Russian Embassy in your country
